name: What's the difference between a pergola and a gazebo?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a pergola and a gazebo?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both pergolas and gazebos provide outdoor shade, they differ in structure and coverage. A pergola features an open roof with a lattice or cross-beams, offering partial shade and an open, airy feel. They are often rectangular and define a specific area. A gazebo, on the other hand, typically has a fully covered, solid roof and often a more enclosed, octagonal or round shape. Gazebos provide more complete protection from sun and rain, creating a more defined outdoor room.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pergolas have an open, latticed roof offering partial shade, while gazebos have a fully covered, solid roof for more complete protection.
